evidence.text: Fourier decomposition separates transverse and longitudinal modes. In the relativistic limit the scalar variable π=m A_L/k supplies Bunch–Davies initial conditions, with P_π=(H_I/2π)² and P_AL,0=(kH_I/(2πm_inf))². Transverse production is neglected because of approximate conformal invariance at small mass.

sources.title: Equivalence Principle Violations and Couplings of a Light Dilaton

evidence.text: Relate scalar charges to derivatives of atomic masses by the chain rule. QCD trace-anomaly and renormalization-group arguments give RG-invariant definitions of d_g and the quark-mass couplings; electromagnetic running is neglected.

sources.title: Variation of $\alpha$ from a Dark Matter Force

evidence.text: Numerically solve the spherical scalar equation for NFW and Burkert halo profiles with ∂rφ(0)=0 and φ(∞)=0. Profiles are normalized to 0.3 GeV/cm³ at r=8.5 kpc; the adopted profile scales are R=20 kpc and rc=10 kpc.

sources.title: The environment dependent dilaton in the laboratory and the solar system

evidence.text: Use Binet's equation and a revolving-orbit angular rescaling, expand a general central force about a nearly circular orbit, and linearize in the added force. The output isolates the combination of force and radial derivative probed by lunar perigee motion.

sources.title: Equivalence Principle Violations and Couplings of a Light Dilaton

evidence.text: Combine a semi-empirical nuclear mass formula with scalar/vector contact-interaction descriptions of nuclear binding and imported chiral/dispersive estimates of two-pion exchange. Infer quark-mass sensitivity through m_π²≈b₀Λ₃m̂, including induced changes in density, asymmetry energy and Coulomb energy.

sources.title: Variation of $\alpha$ from a Dark Matter Force

evidence.text: Use the sourced scalar equation and, for a static approximately uniform distribution larger than relevant scales, φ≈−gXnX/mφ². Muon threshold corrections are expressed as Δα/α=(2α/3π)ln(1+Δmµ/mµ), preserving the logarithm when the mass shift is appreciable.

sources.title: Variation of $\alpha$ from a Dark Matter Force

evidence.text: For cosmology, limit the effective sourcing scale by the horizon when it is smaller than the force range. Estimate φ∼−gXnXdhor², with nX∝T³, using dhor≈2/H in matter domination and 1/H in radiation domination, joined by a simple interpolation.

sources.title: Chameleon vector bosons

evidence.text: Can a light charged scalar make a vector-mediated U(1) force depend strongly on source size, density and environment, thereby weakening bounds inferred from linear-force analyses? Gauged B−L provides the worked example.

sources.title: Dark Energy, the Swampland and the Equivalence Principle

evidence.text: Can early suppression of a scalar-mediated dark-matter force permit appreciable attraction today while retaining acceptable expansion and structure formation? The paper also asks whether the interaction can slow quintessence sufficiently to accommodate a larger exponential-potential slope.

sources.title: Quantum Fine-Tuning in Stringy Quintessence Models

evidence.text: The models must reproduce a very small positive energy density and nearly vacuum-like equation of state. Their scalar must remain light on the present Hubble scale, making even small radiative masses and long-range matter couplings consequential.

sources.title: Fine Tuning, Sequestering, and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can partially sequestered hidden sectors support dark matter or quintessence while remaining weakly coupled to visible matter? The paper offers this as model-building motivation and reports external coupling restrictions without deriving numerical bounds.

sources.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Are the assumed light scalar backgrounds stable against the same tower loops used to estimate their kinetic terms? The answer depends on potential protection, including supersymmetric pairing and the size of splittings within the relevant tower.
